text: Let us recap. In a haloarene the halogen sits on a ring carbon. Dichlorobenzene has three isomers, and para melts highest. Chlorobenzene is made from benzene in the dark with aluminium chloride, or from a diazonium salt by the Sandmeyer reaction. It resists nucleophiles for four reasons: resonance, the s p two carbon, the pi cloud, and no available mechanism, unless nitro groups sit ortho or para. Chlorine is deactivating but ortho para directing. And sodium couples haloarenes in the Fittig and Wurtz Fittig reactions, while chloral gives D D T.
